title: Umnxusi Wendawo Engcwele
intro: Ebusuku obuthule, umphefumulo ozinikele wabiza uMuntu Onomusa ngaphakathi kwezindonga ezingcwele zendawo engcwele. Iminyaka yokholo oluqinile nokubekezela yayizovuzwa ngesimangaliso esasizoletha injabulo kanye nefa lobuprofethi.
clues: Ngachitha izinsuku zami nobusuku bami ngizinikele endlini engcwele engcwele, ngithandaza njalo eNkosini yami.
Ngaguga, kanti umkami wayeyinyumba, kodwa angizange ngilahle ithemba ngesihe sika-Allah.
Nganikwa indodana, egama layo linguYahya, eyaba umprofethi kanye nesibani sokulunga.
Nami ngangingumprofethi, ngithunywe ukuzoqondisa abantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Ngangingowozalo loMprofethi uHarun futhi ngangikhonza njengompristi eThempelini.
Ngaphathiswa ukunakekela uMaryam, unina ka-Isa, futhi ngabona izimangaliso zakhe.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Babuyela kubantu babo ngemuva kokusindiswa enhlanzini

verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
